answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that grows in a spiral with the influence it claims: one identity is cheap, a hundred cost a hundred deposits, so a Sybil farm pays real capital per fake. Newcomers earn weight only through work attested by peers, and a karst-style public audit trail — porous, inspectable, hard to forge — records every attestation. A mirror check then compares claimed activity against that on-chain record, so duplicate identities collapse into one visible pattern and the attacker cost stays high while honest agents keep working.
